migration_steps: Edit requirements.in: change 'Pillow>=12.3.0,<13' to 'Pillow>=13.0.0,<14' (documented as a security fix).
Regenerate the lock file: pip-compile requirements.in -o requirements.txt.
Reinstall the virtualenv to match: pip-sync requirements.txt.
Confirm the bundled Pillow 13.0.0 import and basic Image.open/convert path in a smoke test (no project API change expected).
breaking_changes_expected: Pillow 13.0.0 is a major release; image-load/processing call sites using removed or renamed PIL APIs may surface errors.
No test failures surfaced after the bump, so project-level breakage is unlikely, but a manual review of src/ PIL usage is advised before a wider rollout.

items.rationale: Two Dependabot advisories (GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2, GHSA-5x8w-8jj5-q52h) on certifi >= 2019.03.09, < 2026.10.19; first patched is 2026.10.19. The lock file pinned transitive certifi at 2026.5.20, leaving it exposed. requests 2.34.2 only constrains certifi to >= 2023.5.7, so no compatibility risk exists for bumping.
migration_steps: Edit requirements.in: add 'certifi>=2026.10.19,<2027' as a security pin for the transitive TLS certificate bundle.
Regenerate the lock file: pip-compile requirements.in -o requirements.txt.
